errors.sentence_before_conviction: Can't be before the conviction date
errors.score_invalid: Enter the score as a number

attempts.unreachableBody: You can mark this reference as unreachable. It stays Missing with the reason "Unreachable after 3 attempts".
attempts.title: Attempts
attempts.markedBody: This reference stays Missing with the reason "Unreachable after 3 attempts". Log a new attempt if you reach them.

redFlags.dates_mismatch: Dates differ by more than 31 days
redFlags.owner_not_confirmed: You haven't confirmed who owns or manages the property
redFlags.rent_again_wouldnt_say: Wouldn't say whether they'd rent to them again
redFlags.gap_over_two_months: Gap of more than 2 months between residences

landlord.bothTip: Call both the current and the previous landlord. A current landlord may give a good reference just to see them go.
landlord.step1Body: Don't rely only on the number the applicant gave. Look up the owner in county property records or the management company's website.
landlord.ownerConfirmed: I confirmed this person owns or manages the property
landlord.contactName: Name of the owner or manager you reached
landlord.q4: 4. Did they pay on time and in full?
landlord.q5: 5. Any lease violations (extra occupants, unauthorized pets, noise)?
landlord.q6: 6. How did they leave the unit?
landlord.q8: 8. Do they owe unpaid rent or damages?
landlord.q9: 9. Would you rent to them again?
landlord.emailHint: Opens your mail app with the questions. Evenlease sends nothing.
landlord.noMailApp: No mail app found on this phone.

email.thanks: Thank you for your time. You can reply to this email or call me back.

landlord.subject: Rental reference for {{name}} — {{address}}
landlord.intro: {{name}} has applied to rent a home from me and listed you as the landlord or manager at {{address}}. Could you answer a few questions?
questions: Did they pay on time and in full?
Any lease violations (extra occupants, unauthorized pets, noise)?
How did they leave the unit?
Do they owe unpaid rent or damages?
Would you rent to them again?

service.applicant_copy: The applicant already has a recent report (30 days or less)

report.tooOld: This report is more than 30 days old. Ask for a new one.
report.explain: Screening reports come from licensed companies. The applicant pays and enters their SSN on the company's site — you never handle it.
report.companyHelp: Copy these from the top of the report. Needed for an adverse action notice.
report.companyMissing: Name, mailing address and phone are needed before you can create an adverse action notice.
report.caseDateHelp: As shown on the report: 2021, 2021-06 or 2021-06-15.
report.collections: Collections owed to a landlord or property manager
report.keyFactorsHelp: Up to 4, as listed on the report. Needed for an adverse action notice.
report.noFiles: Attach the report (PDF or photos) so you can show what you relied on.
report.cameraDenied: Camera access is off. Turn it on in your phone's settings.
report.photosDenied: Photo access is off. Turn it on in your phone's settings.
report.attachFailed: Couldn't attach the file. Try again.
report.fixErrors: Fix the highlighted fields to save.
report.removeBody: The results and attached files are deleted from this phone. This can't be undone.

block.not_entered: Enter the convictions, or choose None.
block.no_convictions_in_lookback: There are no convictions in the lookback period to base a withdrawal on.
block.assessment_required: Answer the individual assessment questions first.
block.not_editable: This review can't be changed now.

background.lockedTitle: Unlocks after you make a conditional offer.
background.lockedBody: Criminal history is reviewed only as a second step, and only for convictions.
background.offTitle: Criminal history isn't in this rental's criteria.
background.offBody: Evenlease reviews convictions only when your published criteria include it.
background.lawBanner: Some cities and states ban or delay criminal history checks (e.g. NYC, Maryland, Oakland, Berkeley, Seattle, Portland, Cook County). Check your local law.
background.readOnly: This review is part of the record and can't be changed now.
background.noneA11y_one: No convictions in the past {{count}} year
background.noneA11y_other: No convictions in the past {{count}} years
background.arrests: Arrests without a conviction must not be considered.
background.q1: How serious was it, and how does it relate to the safety of residents or property?
background.q3: Any evidence of rehabilitation or good tenant history since?
background.q4: Anything else the applicant told you?
background.neverAuto: A conviction never rules anyone out automatically. Decide after weighing these answers.
background.noneInLookback: No conviction falls inside the lookback period, so none is considered.
background.continued: Background review saved — the offer stands.

employer.step1Body: Find the employer's main number yourself (company website or directory) and ask for HR or payroll.
employer.contactName: Who you spoke with (HR or payroll)
employer.note: Many employers only confirm dates and title. Verify income with pay stubs instead.
